description.text: Dogs are mammals that often live with people. They come in many shapes and sizes. Dogs use sounds and body movements to communicate, and their noses help them explore the world.

habitat.text: Homes and other places where people live around the world.

environment_role.text: Companion animal; some trained dogs help people with jobs.

description.text: Cats are mammals with fur and whiskers. Their whiskers help them sense nearby things. Cats use sounds like meows and purrs to communicate. Many cats live with people as pets.

habitat.text: Homes and other places near people around the world.

environment_role.text: Companion animal; cats also hunt small animals.

notes.text: Cats use their tongues to groom their fur.

description.text: A red maple is a tree that grows across Ohio. Its leaves have pointed sections called lobes. In fall, its leaves can turn red or orange. Its seeds have little wings.

habitat.text: Moist places across Ohio, including low ground and woods.

environment_role.text: Some mammals eat parts of this tree.

physical_dimensions.text: Often 60 to 80 feet tall when grown.

notes.text: This card is for red maple. Other kinds of maple trees also grow in Ohio.

description.text: Kentucky bluegrass is one kind of grass that can grow in an Ohio lawn. It has green leaves and spreads with stems under the ground. A lawn can have several kinds of grass together.

habitat.text: Lawns, including sunny lawns in Ohio.

environment_role.text: Grows as a mat of grass used to cover lawns.

physical_dimensions.text: Uncut leaves can grow up to 18 inches long.

notes.text: This is one lawn-grass species, not a name for every patch of grass.

description.text: An American robin is a bird with a reddish-brown chest. You may see one hopping across a lawn. Robins eat worms, insects, and fruit. They often build nests in trees.

environment_role.text: Eats small animals such as worms and insects, as well as fruit.

notes.text: Many robins stay in colder places through winter if they can find food.
